setup.en: Set a rack's hooks near upper-chest height with room overhead and in front. Use a light training bar if an empty Olympic bar is too heavy; secure any plates with collars.
setup.zh: 把架子挂钩调到上胸附近，头顶和前方留出空间。空奥林匹克杠仍太重时，用更轻的训练杠；加杠片后扣好卡扣。

steps.en: Stand close to the bar and take a slightly wider-than-shoulder overhand grip, thumbs wrapped around it. Let the bar rest over the heel of the palm with wrists nearly straight.
steps.zh: 站近杠铃，正握，握距比肩稍宽，拇指扣住杠。杠压在掌根上，手腕尽量平直。

steps.en: Lift the bar from the hooks and step back carefully. Plant the feet about hip-width apart; brace the abdomen and keep ribs over the pelvis, with elbows slightly in front of the bar.
steps.zh: 把杠从挂钩上取下，小心后退。双脚约髋宽踩稳；腹部收紧，胸廓叠在骨盆上，手肘略在杠前。

steps.en: Breathe out as you press upward, moving the chin back just enough for the bar to clear the face. Keep the knees still rather than dipping and driving with the legs.
steps.zh: 呼气向上推，下巴稍往后收，让杠避开脸。膝盖保持稳定，不靠先蹲再伸腿把杠顶起来。

steps.en: Once the bar clears the forehead, bring the head under it without arching the back. Finish with arms almost straight and the bar over the shoulders and midfoot; allow the shoulder blades to rotate upward.
steps.zh: 杠越过额头后，把头送回杠下，不要弓腰。顶端手臂接近伸直，杠在肩膀和脚中部上方；让肩胛骨自然上回旋。

steps.en: Breathe in and lower along the same close path to the upper chest. Move the chin clear again and keep the abdomen braced rather than catching the bar abruptly.
steps.zh: 吸气，沿靠近身体的路线慢慢放回上胸。下巴再次避开杠，腹部保持支撑，不要突然接住下落的杠。

steps.en: To finish, step towards the rack with the bar controlled at the upper chest, touch both uprights and settle it onto both hooks before releasing the grip.
steps.zh: 结束时，稳住上胸处的杠，向架子走近，先贴到两侧立柱，再落到两边挂钩上，确认稳妥后松手。

cues.en: Keep the ribs over the pelvis as the hands rise.
cues.zh: 手抬高，胸廓仍叠在骨盆上。

cues.en: Move the bar close to the face, then stack it over the body.
cues.zh: 杠贴近脸部通过，再叠到身体上方。

cues.en: Feel the front and side shoulders and the backs of the arms working together.
cues.zh: 肩前部、肩外侧和上臂后方一起用力。

mistakes.en: Leaning back to clear the bar. Why: this substitutes trunk extension for shoulder elevation and changes the load path.
mistakes.zh: 靠后仰给杠让路。为什么：躯干后伸代替了肩部抬举，也改变了负重路线。

mistakes.en: Holding the blades down at the top. Why: overhead lifting needs scapular upward rotation, so pinning them limits the movement.
mistakes.zh: 顶端仍把肩胛骨压住。为什么：举过头顶需要肩胛骨上回旋，压住会限制动作。

text.en: Begin with a load or variation you can control and progress gradually when the same movement feels easy.
text.zh: 从能够控制的重量或版本开始，等同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Train regularly while allowing recovery, including the shoulder work already done in chest and back training.
text.zh: 规律训练并留出恢复时间，把胸部和背部训练中肩部已经承担的工作也算进去。

text.en: You do not need to reach failure to benefit from resistance training.
text.zh: 力量训练不需要每次都练到力竭才能获益。

cautions.en: Do not attempt a load you cannot lower and re-rack; learn how to stop a failed lift with a coach before progressing.
cautions.zh: 不要用无法稳稳放下、挂回架子的重量；加重前先跟教练学会推不动时如何安全结束。

cautions.en: Stop for sharp shoulder pain, tingling or a sudden loss of control.
cautions.zh: 肩部出现刺痛、麻刺感或突然失控时，停下。

cautions.en: For a first attempt, use bodyweight or a light load and learn with a qualified coach; anyone under 18 should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

text.en: Research shows: fifteen healthy men performed seated and standing barbell and dumbbell presses with a load based on their maximum in each version. Deltoid EMG differed with the equipment and body position; this compares those tested conditions, not which exercise grows the muscle most.
text.zh: 研究显示：十五名健康男性用各版本自身最大重量为依据的负荷，比较坐姿与站姿的杠铃、哑铃推举。三角肌肌电随器械与体位而不同；这是对研究条件的比较，不能据此判断哪个动作最能增肌。

name.zh: 哑铃侧平举（路线稍靠前）

setup.en: Choose light dumbbells and leave room to open the arms. This version travels slightly forward of a pure side raise, with thumbs level or slightly upward.
setup.zh: 选轻哑铃，给抬臂留出空间。本页版本的路线比纯侧举略靠前，拇指平放或略朝上。

steps.en: Stand tall with feet about hip-width apart and knees relaxed. Hold the dumbbells beside the thighs, palms facing inward.
steps.zh: 双脚约髋宽站稳，膝盖放松。哑铃放在大腿两侧，掌心向内。

steps.en: Bend the elbows slightly and keep that bend throughout. Brace gently so the ribs do not lift as the arms move.
steps.zh: 肘微屈，整个动作保持这个角度。腹部轻轻收紧，抬臂时胸廓不要向上翻。

steps.en: Breathe out and lift the upper arms out and slightly forward. Let the shoulder blades follow the arms rather than squeezing them together.
steps.zh: 呼气，上臂向侧面、略向前抬。让肩胛骨跟着手臂动，不要一直夹紧。

steps.en: Stop around shoulder height, or earlier if that is your comfortable range. Keep hands and elbows at similar height without turning the thumbs sharply downward.
steps.zh: 抬到肩高附近，或在自己舒服的范围内更早停下。手和肘大致同高，不要刻意把拇指猛转向下。

steps.en: Pause without hiking the shoulders, then breathe in and lower slowly to the sides. Reset your balance before the next lift.
steps.zh: 停一下，不靠猛耸肩维持；吸气，慢慢放回体侧。重新站稳再抬。

cues.en: Lead with the upper arms; keep the same small elbow bend.
cues.zh: 让上臂带着走，屈肘角度保持不变。

cues.en: Raise only as far as you can lower smoothly.
cues.zh: 只抬到还能平稳放下的高度。

cues.en: Effort belongs around the side of the shoulder, without a joint pinch.
cues.zh: 用力感在肩外侧附近，关节里面不应有夹痛。

mistakes.en: Swinging the hips to launch the dumbbells. Why: momentum moves the load while the shoulders lose control.
mistakes.zh: 摆髋把哑铃甩起来。为什么：惯性带动负重，肩部失去控制。

mistakes.en: Shrugging before the upper arms rise. Why: the movement becomes mainly a shoulder-girdle hike instead of an arm raise.
mistakes.zh: 上臂还没抬就先猛耸肩。为什么：动作主要变成肩带上提，而不是抬臂。

text.en: Begin with a load or variation you can control and progress gradually when the same movement feels easy.
text.zh: 从能够控制的重量或版本开始，等同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Train regularly while allowing recovery, including the shoulder work already done in chest and back training.
text.zh: 规律训练并留出恢复时间，把胸部和背部训练中肩部已经承担的工作也算进去。

text.en: You do not need to reach failure to benefit from resistance training.
text.zh: 力量训练不需要每次都练到力竭才能获益。

cautions.en: Reduce the load or range if you cannot avoid a painful arc; stop if discomfort persists.
cautions.zh: 经过某段角度会痛时，先减重或缩小幅度；不适持续就停下。

cautions.en: For a first attempt, use bodyweight or a light load and learn with a qualified coach; anyone under 18 should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Use a firm non-slip floor. Start with a shallow, bent-knee pike and a comfortable depth; a floor pike is demanding even without added weight.
setup.zh: 使用结实、不打滑的地面。先选髋部抬得较低、膝盖稍弯的版本，下降幅度以能控制为准；不加重量的地面版本也可能很吃力。

steps.en: Place palms about shoulder-width apart with fingers spread. Step the feet back, then lift the hips so the torso and legs form an inverted V.
steps.zh: 双手约肩宽撑地，手指张开。脚向后迈，再抬髋，让躯干和腿形成倒 V 形。

steps.en: Keep the spine long and bend the knees if needed. Look between the hands; press through the whole palm and keep your weight supported by hands and feet.
steps.zh: 脊柱保持自然伸展，需要时弯膝。看两手之间，用整个手掌撑地，体重由手脚承担。

steps.en: Breathe in, bend the elbows diagonally back and lower the head towards a point just ahead of the hands. Keep the hips high without dropping the chest into an ordinary push-up.
steps.zh: 吸气，手肘斜向后屈，头朝两手连线前方一点的地面下降。髋部保持抬高，不要落成普通俯卧撑。

steps.en: Stop before the head bears weight, at a depth you can reverse smoothly. The elbows stay controlled rather than flaring straight out.
steps.zh: 在头部承重之前停下，深度要保证能平稳推回。肘受控移动，不要完全张向两侧。

steps.en: Breathe out and push the floor away until the arms are nearly straight. Let the blades rotate upward while keeping the same pike shape.
steps.zh: 呼气，把地面推开，直到手臂接近伸直。肩胛骨自然上回旋，身体维持原来的折髋形状。

steps.en: To finish, lower the knees to the floor under control before taking the hands away.
steps.zh: 结束时，先有控制地把膝盖放到地面，再把手收回。

cues.en: Hips stay high while the elbows bend.
cues.zh: 屈肘时，髋部仍抬高。

cues.en: Push through the palms; the head is not a support point.
cues.zh: 用手掌推地，头不是支撑点。

mistakes.en: Collapsing onto the head. Why: the neck takes load that should remain supported by the arms and feet.
mistakes.zh: 塌下去压在头上。为什么：本应由手臂和脚承担的负重落到了颈部。

mistakes.en: Letting the hips fall as you descend. Why: it changes the pressing angle and no longer matches the shoulder-focused movement.
mistakes.zh: 下降时髋部跟着落下。为什么：推的角度改变，不再是图中的肩部推举动作。

text.en: Begin with a load or variation you can control and progress gradually when the same movement feels easy.
text.zh: 从能够控制的重量或版本开始，等同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Train regularly while allowing recovery, including the shoulder work already done in chest and back training.
text.zh: 规律训练并留出恢复时间，把胸部和背部训练中肩部已经承担的工作也算进去。

text.en: You do not need to reach failure to benefit from resistance training.
text.zh: 力量训练不需要每次都练到力竭才能获益。

cautions.en: This is a demanding progression: first learn to control ordinary or incline push-ups with a qualified coach. Stop before the head becomes a support point.
cautions.zh: 这是较吃力的进阶动作：先在合格教练指导下学会控制普通或上斜俯卧撑。头部承重前就应停止下放。

cautions.en: If you cannot keep the head clear of the floor, practise an easier supported pressing variation with a coach.
cautions.zh: 无法避免头部压地时，请教练带你改练更容易的支撑推举版本。

cautions.en: Stop for wrist or shoulder pain, dizziness or loss of balance.
cautions.zh: 手腕或肩部疼痛、头晕或失去平衡时，停下。

cautions.en: For a first attempt, use bodyweight or a light load and learn with a qualified coach; anyone under 18 should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

name.zh: 胸托哑铃划船（肘略外展）

setup.en: Use a stable inclined bench and light dumbbells. Keep the elbows moderately out from the torso so the arms move back and out; this version shares work between the rear shoulder and upper back.
setup.zh: 用稳固的上斜凳和轻哑铃。肘与躯干保持适度距离，让上臂向后、向外移动；本页版本由肩后部和上背部共同用力。

steps.en: Lie chest-down on the inclined pad with feet planted wide enough for balance. Keep the neck in line with the back and the chest supported throughout.
steps.zh: 胸部朝下靠在斜凳上，双脚分开到能站稳的距离。颈部与背部自然连成一线，胸部始终有支撑。

steps.en: Let the arms hang beneath the shoulders. Hold the dumbbells with palms facing back or slightly inward, wrists straight; allow a comfortable forward glide of the blades.
steps.zh: 双臂从肩下自然垂下。掌心朝后或略朝内握哑铃，手腕平直；肩胛骨可以在舒服的范围内略向前滑。

steps.en: Breathe out and guide the elbows back and moderately outward. Let the shoulder blades draw together without pulling the chest away from the pad.
steps.zh: 呼气，让肘向后并适度向外走。肩胛骨随之向内收，胸部保持贴住凳面。

steps.en: Stop with the elbows around the line of the torso and the dumbbells beside the upper ribs. Keep the chest on the pad rather than lifting it to make room.
steps.zh: 手肘到躯干平面附近、哑铃来到上位肋骨两侧时停下。胸部贴住靠垫，不要为了拉得更高而挺起。

steps.en: Pause briefly, then breathe in and lower until the arms hang again. Let the blades glide forward without rounding the whole back; place the weights down before leaving the bench.
steps.zh: 停一下，再吸气，慢慢放到双臂重新垂下。让肩胛骨向前滑，不要把整个背拱起；先放好哑铃再离开凳子。

cues.en: Keep the chest on the pad while the upper arms move.
cues.zh: 胸贴靠垫，让上臂移动。

cues.en: Feel the back of the shoulder and the area between the blades working together.
cues.zh: 肩后部和两块肩胛骨之间一起用力。

mistakes.en: Lifting the chest away from the pad. Why: trunk movement supplies momentum and changes the intended arm path.
mistakes.zh: 胸部离开靠垫。为什么：躯干提供了惯性，也改变了原定的上臂路线。

mistakes.en: Yanking the elbows far past the body. Why: added range can pull the shoulder forward instead of finishing a controlled row.
mistakes.zh: 猛把肘拉到身体后面很远。为什么：额外幅度可能让肩前部向前顶，而不是完成受控的划船。

text.en: Begin with a load or variation you can control and progress gradually when the same movement feels easy.
text.zh: 从能够控制的重量或版本开始，等同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Train regularly while allowing recovery, including the shoulder work already done in chest and back training.
text.zh: 规律训练并留出恢复时间，把胸部和背部训练中肩部已经承担的工作也算进去。

text.en: You do not need to reach failure to benefit from resistance training.
text.zh: 力量训练不需要每次都练到力竭才能获益。

cautions.en: Shorten the pull if the front of the shoulder feels strained; stop for pain.
cautions.zh: 肩前部觉得被拉得难受时，缩短后拉幅度；疼痛就停下。

cautions.en: For a first attempt, use bodyweight or a light load and learn with a qualified coach; anyone under 18 should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Set a single pulley near elbow height with a D-handle and a very light load. Stand side-on, with the working arm farther from the column so the cable crosses in front of you; use a small towel between elbow and ribs if helpful.
setup.zh: 把单滑轮调到肘高，装 D 形把手，选很轻的配重。侧对器械，工作侧手臂远离立柱，让绳索从身前经过；需要时在肘和肋骨间夹一小块毛巾。

steps.en: Take the handle in the working hand with the thumb up. Stand tall with feet planted and the elbow beside the ribs, bent about 90°.
steps.zh: 工作侧握把手，拇指向上。站直、双脚踩稳，肘靠近肋骨，屈肘约 90°。

steps.en: Begin with the forearm angled inward across the abdomen, within a comfortable range. Keep the wrist straight and the shoulder relaxed rather than pulled forward.
steps.zh: 前臂从舒服的向内斜放位置开始，靠近腹前。手腕平直，肩部放松，不向前顶。

steps.en: Breathe out and rotate the upper arm outward so the hand traces an arc away from the abdomen. The elbow stays in place and the torso faces the same direction.
steps.zh: 呼气，让上臂向外转，手沿弧线离开腹部。手肘留在原位，躯干保持原来的朝向。

steps.en: Stop while the elbow and torso remain still and before the shoulder feels strained; the end position is a comfortable outward turn rather than a required angle.
steps.zh: 肘和躯干仍能保持稳定、肩部未被拉得难受时就停；终点是舒服的向外旋转，而不是规定角度。

steps.en: Breathe in and return slowly along the arc without letting the stack crash. After finishing, return the handle under control, then repeat with the other arm.
steps.zh: 吸气，沿弧线慢慢转回，不让配重片砸下。结束后稳稳送回把手，再换另一侧。

cues.en: Keep the elbow as a quiet hinge point; turn at the shoulder.
cues.zh: 手肘留稳，转动发生在肩关节。

cues.en: Turn the upper arm, not the wrist or the whole body.
cues.zh: 转上臂，不甩手腕，也不转整个身体。

cues.en: Expect shared effort behind the shoulder, not a sharp joint pain.
cues.zh: 肩后部几块肌肉一起用力，关节里不应刺痛。

mistakes.en: Twisting the torso to pull the handle. Why: body rotation moves the cable without training the intended shoulder rotation.
mistakes.zh: 转身拉把手。为什么：躯干旋转带动绳索，代替了原定的肩外旋。

mistakes.en: Letting the elbow drift outward. Why: abduction changes the exercise and allows a heavier load than this small rotation can control.
mistakes.zh: 肘向外漂。为什么：外展改变了动作，也让负重超过这段小幅旋转能够控制的程度。

text.en: Begin with a load or variation you can control and progress gradually when the same movement feels easy.
text.zh: 从能够控制的重量或版本开始，等同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Train regularly while allowing recovery, including the shoulder work already done in chest and back training.
text.zh: 规律训练并留出恢复时间，把胸部和背部训练中肩部已经承担的工作也算进去。

text.en: You do not need to reach failure to benefit from resistance training.
text.zh: 力量训练不需要每次都练到力竭才能获益。

cautions.en: This is an exercise example for general fitness, not a post-injury or post-surgery rehabilitation prescription.
cautions.zh: 这是一般健身动作示例，不是伤后或术后康复处方。

cautions.en: Keep the load light and stop if pain, tingling or a feeling of slipping occurs.
cautions.zh: 保持轻重量；出现疼痛、麻刺感或像关节要滑脱的感觉时，停下。

cautions.en: For a first attempt, use bodyweight or a light load and learn with a qualified coach; anyone under 18 should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

text.en: Reinold, Wilk, Fleisig and colleagues (2004) used intramuscular EMG in ten healthy people during seven external-rotation exercise variants, including standing rotation with the arm at the side. This card uses a cable, so it does not inherit a ranking from their tested variants; EMG does not establish greater muscle growth (Vigotsky and colleagues, 2018).
text.zh: Reinold、Wilk、Fleisig 等（2004）用肌内电极记录十名健康受试者做七种肩外旋动作时的肌电，其中包括上臂贴体侧的站姿外旋。本卡片使用绳索，不能直接套用研究中不同版本的排名；肌电也不能证明增肌更多（Vigotsky 等，2018）。

setup.en: Set a pulley near elbow height with a D-handle and a very light load. Stand side-on with the working arm nearer the column so the cable pulls the forearm outward; a small towel beside the elbow can help mark its position.
setup.zh: 把单滑轮调到肘高，装 D 形把手，选很轻的配重。侧对器械，工作侧手臂靠近立柱，让绳索向外拉前臂；肘边的小毛巾可以帮助记住手肘位置。

steps.en: Hold the handle with the thumb up and wrist straight. Plant the feet and keep the elbow beside the ribs, bent about 90°.
steps.zh: 握把手，拇指向上，手腕平直。双脚踩稳，肘靠近肋骨，屈肘约 90°。

steps.en: Start with the forearm angled slightly outward, only as far as the shoulder can stay comfortable and still. Keep the ribs facing forward.
steps.zh: 前臂略向外斜放，幅度以肩部舒服、稳定为准。胸廓朝前，不跟着转。

steps.en: Breathe out and rotate the upper arm inward, bringing the hand towards the abdomen in an arc. Keep the elbow at the same spot.
steps.zh: 呼气，让上臂向内转，手沿弧线靠近腹部。手肘留在同一位置。

steps.en: Stop near the abdomen without pressing the handle into it or pulling the whole shoulder forward. The wrist remains straight and the elbow stays bent.
steps.zh: 靠近腹部时停下，不把把手压进肚子，也不让整个肩膀向前跑。手腕仍平直，屈肘角度不变。

steps.en: Breathe in and let the cable draw the forearm back slowly. Return the handle under control at the end, then set up for the other side.
steps.zh: 吸气，让绳索慢慢带前臂转回。结束后稳稳送回把手，再换另一侧。

cues.en: Turn around the upper arm; keep the elbow beside the ribs.
cues.zh: 围绕上臂转，肘留在肋骨旁。

cues.en: Use a small clean arc with a quiet torso.
cues.zh: 弧线小而清楚，躯干稳住。

mistakes.en: Dragging the elbow across the body. Why: horizontal adduction replaces the intended rotation.
mistakes.zh: 把肘横拉过身体。为什么：水平内收代替了原定的肩内旋。

mistakes.en: Bending the wrist to finish. Why: the hand moves while the humerus barely rotates.
mistakes.zh: 末端靠屈腕完成。为什么：手在动，肱骨却几乎没转。

text.en: Begin with a load or variation you can control and progress gradually when the same movement feels easy.
text.zh: 从能够控制的重量或版本开始，等同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Train regularly while allowing recovery, including the shoulder work already done in chest and back training.
text.zh: 规律训练并留出恢复时间，把胸部和背部训练中肩部已经承担的工作也算进去。

text.en: You do not need to reach failure to benefit from resistance training.
text.zh: 力量训练不需要每次都练到力竭才能获益。

cautions.en: Do not force the starting outward rotation or use this card as rehabilitation after injury or surgery.
cautions.zh: 不要强迫起始外旋幅度，也不要把本卡片当作伤后或术后康复处方。

cautions.en: For a first attempt, use bodyweight or a light load and learn with a qualified coach; anyone under 18 should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Fit a short straight bar to a high pulley and choose a light load. Face the column and step back enough that the arms can rise comfortably without the stack resting between movements.
setup.zh: 高滑轮装短直杆，选轻重量。面对器械，后退到手臂能舒服抬起、动作间配重仍略悬起的位置。

steps.en: Grip the bar overhand about shoulder-width apart. Plant the feet, soften the knees and hinge slightly at the hips with the spine neutral.
steps.zh: 正握直杆，握距约肩宽。脚踩稳，膝微屈，从髋部略向前折，脊柱保持自然。

steps.en: Begin with the arms raised in front, around face height in the drawing. Keep a small elbow bend that stays the same and the ribs over the pelvis.
steps.zh: 从手臂在身前抬起的位置开始，图中约到面部高度。肘保持轻微弯曲，胸廓与骨盆相对稳定。

steps.en: Breathe out and bring the upper arms down towards the sides, carrying the bar in an arc towards the thighs. Keep the torso at its starting angle.
steps.zh: 呼气，让上臂向下回到体侧，直杆沿弧线来到大腿前。躯干保持起始角度。

steps.en: Stop with the hands near the front of the thighs; do not drive the elbows behind the body or straighten them suddenly to finish.
steps.zh: 手来到大腿前附近就停，不把肘硬推到身后，也不靠突然伸肘完成末端。

steps.en: Breathe in and let the arms return upward slowly, allowing the shoulder blades to follow. Stay within a range you can reverse without arching the back; return the bar before releasing it.
steps.zh: 吸气，慢慢让手臂抬回，肩胛骨随之活动。幅度要保证不用弓腰就能平稳拉回；结束前先稳稳送回直杆再松手。

cues.en: Move the upper arms; keep the elbow bend unchanged.
cues.zh: 移动上臂，屈肘角度不变。

cues.en: Feel the back folds of the armpits and sides of the back sharing the work.
cues.zh: 腋后襞和背部两侧共同用力。

cues.en: The long head of triceps can assist at the shoulder; its other heads act at the elbow.
cues.zh: 肱三头肌长头可协助肩部动作，其他头作用于肘。

mistakes.en: Bending and straightening the elbows to move the bar. Why: it becomes an elbow pushdown instead of shoulder extension.
mistakes.zh: 靠反复屈伸肘移动直杆。为什么：动作变成伸肘下压，代替了肩关节伸。

mistakes.en: Rocking the torso forward and back. Why: body movement pulls the cable and changes the shoulder range.
mistakes.zh: 躯干前后摆。为什么：身体摆动拉动了绳索，也改变了肩部活动幅度。

text.en: Begin with a load or variation you can control and progress gradually when the same movement feels easy.
text.zh: 从能够控制的重量或版本开始，等同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Train regularly while allowing recovery, including the shoulder work already done in chest and back training.
text.zh: 规律训练并留出恢复时间，把胸部和背部训练中肩部已经承担的工作也算进去。

text.en: You do not need to reach failure to benefit from resistance training.
text.zh: 力量训练不需要每次都练到力竭才能获益。

cautions.en: Do not let the cable drag the arms into a painful overhead range or pull you off balance.
cautions.zh: 不要任由绳索把手臂拉到疼痛的举臂范围，也不要被拉得失去平衡。

cautions.en: For a first attempt, use bodyweight or a light load and learn with a qualified coach; anyone under 18 should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

name.en: Dumbbell pullover on a flat bench

setup.en: Use a stable flat bench, lying along it so the head, upper back and buttocks are supported. Choose a light fixed-head dumbbell that can be safely held by both hands beneath its upper head; do not use a loose plate-loaded dumbbell.
setup.zh: 使用稳固的平板凳，沿凳面躺下，让头、上背和臀部都有支撑。选轻的固定头哑铃，两手能稳稳托住上端铃头下方；不要用杠片可能松动的可拆式哑铃。

steps.en: Sit with the dumbbell close to the chest, then lie back carefully or have a helper hand it to you once you are supported. Plant both feet.
steps.zh: 先坐好，把哑铃收近胸口，再小心躺下；也可以躺稳后请人递给你。双脚踩稳。

steps.en: Hold the upper head securely with both palms beneath it and thumbs around the handle. Position it above the shoulders, elbows softly bent, with the head resting on the bench.
steps.zh: 两掌托稳上端铃头，拇指环绕握柄。哑铃在肩膀上方，肘微屈，头部贴着凳面。

steps.en: Breathe in and lower the weight in an arc towards the space above and behind the head. Keep the elbow bend nearly unchanged and let the shoulders move without lifting the ribs.
steps.zh: 吸气，沿弧线把哑铃向头顶后方放。屈肘角度基本不变，让肩关节活动，胸廓不要向上翻。

steps.en: Stop before the low back arches or the shoulder feels pulled beyond a comfortable range. The drawing uses arms short of being fully overhead; it does not ask the weight to drop below the bench.
steps.zh: 在下背开始弓起或肩部被拉得难受之前停下。图中手臂没有放到完全举过头顶，不要求哑铃沉到凳面以下。

steps.en: Breathe out and draw the upper arms back towards the chest, bringing the dumbbell above the shoulders again. Keep the pelvis and head on the bench.
steps.zh: 呼气，让上臂向胸前带回，哑铃回到肩膀上方。骨盆和头部始终贴着凳面。

steps.en: To finish, bring the dumbbell to the chest, then sit up with help if needed and place it down securely; do not drop it behind the bench.
steps.zh: 结束时先把哑铃收到胸前，需要时请人帮助坐起，再稳稳放下；不要把哑铃往凳后扔。

cues.en: Move at the shoulders; keep the same small elbow bend.
cues.zh: 主要动肩关节，肘的轻微弯曲保持不变。

cues.en: Use the range your shoulders can control without the ribs lifting.
cues.zh: 选择肩部能控制、胸廓不向上翻的幅度。

cues.en: Work may be shared by the chest and back folds of the armpits.
cues.zh: 用力感可能同时在胸前和腋后襞。

mistakes.en: Arching the back to lower farther. Why: trunk extension creates apparent shoulder range that the shoulders are not controlling.
mistakes.zh: 弓腰让哑铃放得更远。为什么：躯干后伸制造了看起来更大的肩部幅度，肩部却没有控制这段运动。

mistakes.en: Changing elbow bend to curl the weight back. Why: the movement shifts towards elbow work rather than the intended shoulder arc.
mistakes.zh: 靠改变屈肘角度把重量弯举回来。为什么：动作转成主要用肘，而不是原定的肩部弧线。

text.en: Begin with a load or variation you can control and progress gradually when the same movement feels easy.
text.zh: 从能够控制的重量或版本开始，等同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Train regularly while allowing recovery, including the shoulder work already done in chest and back training.
text.zh: 规律训练并留出恢复时间，把胸部和背部训练中肩部已经承担的工作也算进去。

text.en: You do not need to reach failure to benefit from resistance training.
text.zh: 力量训练不需要每次都练到力竭才能获益。

cautions.en: The long head of triceps can assist at the shoulder; its other heads act at the elbow.
cautions.zh: 肱三头肌长头可协助肩部动作，其他头作用于肘。

cautions.en: Check the grip before lying back and avoid any dumbbell with a loose head or plates.
cautions.zh: 躺下前先确认握得稳，不用铃头或杠片松动的哑铃。

cautions.en: Do not force an overhead stretch; stop for shoulder or elbow pain.
cautions.zh: 不要硬追求头顶后的拉伸幅度；肩部或肘部疼痛时停下。

cautions.en: For a first attempt, use bodyweight or a light load and learn with a qualified coach; anyone under 18 should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

cautions.en: The supplied sketch changes the elbow bend more than intended. Keep the initial slight bend fixed and move the upper arms at the shoulders rather than bending and straightening the elbows.
cautions.zh: 现有示意图的肘弯变化比本动作要求的大。保持起始时轻微屈肘的角度，用肩关节移动上臂，不要靠反复屈伸肘完成动作。
